title: FinishedResponsesToProcessStuckJobs
description: A retrieved OpenAI Response (the response to check_response_finished_to_ticket_generator), as check-stale-jobs reads it: the same reading as tickets_to_process_tickets, so a completed response whose output text does not match the ticket format counts as one that could not be checked. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

status.description: The response's status; one without a status is a generation error.

output.description: What the model produced; empty when missing. Read only once the status is completed, when its output text must match ticket_format_to_ticket_generator (an empty text, as after a refusal, does not).

output_item.description: One item of the response's output.

type.description: Only items of type message carry content.

content_part.description: One part of an output message.

type.description: Only parts of type output_text carry text.

text.description: The text of an output_text part. The texts of every output_text part of every message, joined in order, are the output text: JSON in the ticket format.
